verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs claim that "Reframe handles every aspect ratio," and that Modify Video V2 outputs "all at 1080p." However, no evidence explicitly lists 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 as native generation options, and 1080p is documented only for Modify Video, not general text- or image-to-video. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported aspect ratios (16:9/9:16/1:1) for native generation, documented 1080p-or-above output for standard generation, confirmation that delivery formats need no re-encoding, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding
